title: Questions and answers: Searchable FAQ
description: Questions and answers, Searchable FAQ layout only

files.content:
// @zeus-internal
import type { ArtemisFaqQuestion } from "../../content";
export const defaultQuestions: ArtemisFaqQuestion[] = [
    { id: "trial", category: "Getting started", question: "Can I try the product before choosing a plan?", answer: "Yes. Every workspace starts with a 14-day trial, and you can explore the full product without adding a payment method." },
    { id: "invite", category: "Getting started", question: "How do I bring my team in?", answer: "Invite people by email or share a private join link. You can change roles and access at any time from workspace settings." },
    { id: "import", category: "Getting started", question: "Can I move my existing work over?", answer: "You can import common file formats or start from a template. Our support team can also help with larger moves." },
    { id: "plans", category: "Billing", question: "What is included in each plan?", answer: "Every plan includes the core workspace. Higher plans add more guests, longer history, and organization controls for larger teams." },
    { id: "change-plan", category: "Billing", question: "Can I change my plan later?", answer: "Anytime. Upgrades take effect immediately, while downgrades begin at the end of your current billing period." },
    { id: "annual", category: "Billing", question: "Do you offer annual billing?", answer: "Yes. Annual plans include two months at no additional cost and use the same features and support as monthly plans." },
    { id: "ownership", category: "Privacy", question: "Who owns the content we add?", answer: "You do. Your team keeps ownership of everything it creates and can export workspace content whenever needed." },
    { id: "access", category: "Privacy", question: "Can guests see the whole workspace?", answer: "No. Guests only see the spaces and pages you explicitly share with them, and their access can be removed instantly." },
    { id: "delete", category: "Privacy", question: "What happens when I delete a workspace?", answer: "The workspace enters a 30-day recovery period before permanent deletion. Owners receive a confirmation before that period ends." },
    { id: "response", category: "Support", question: "How quickly will support reply?", answer: "Most questions receive a reply within one business day. Priority plans include a faster response window for urgent issues." },
    { id: "cancel", category: "Support", question: "What happens if I cancel?", answer: "Your paid features remain available until the end of the billing period. After that, the workspace moves to the free plan." },
    { id: "contact", category: "Support", question: "Can I speak with a real person?", answer: "Always. Send us a note from the help menu and a member of the team will reply\u2014no automated support loop." },
];
